title: AUE
features:
-- دوگمەی سێیەم: گۆڕینی Gravity

local btn3 = Instance.new("TextButton")
btn3.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50)
btn3.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0.8, 0)
btn3.Text = "Gravity"
btn3.TextScaled = true
btn3.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
btn3.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
btn3.Parent = screenGui

local gravityChanged = false

btn3.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    gravityChanged = not gravityChanged
    if gravityChanged then
        workspace.Gravity = 50  -- Gravity کم دەکات
        btn3.Text = "Gravity Low"
    else
        workspace.Gravity = 196.2  -- Gravity Normal
        btn3.Text = "Gravity Normal"
    end
end)
